title: give the UI pass a render command (for example a test flag that writes a command's help block as plain text to a given directory) so help renders do not have to be copied from source by hand

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The ui reported this as tool feedback (deterministic-check) on ork in ork run ork-20261119-125646-0803, project ork, item S338:

give the UI pass a render command (for example a test flag that writes a command's help block as plain text to a given directory) so help renders do not have to be copied from source by hand

Evidence: go run ./cmd/ork run --help was denied in the UI sandbox, so the renders were copied from cli.go lines 62-86 and 96-108
